message:
The yen receipt test passes now. The full suite is green: 18 pass, 0 fail.

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` always divided the amount by 100. JPY has no minor unit, so `500` rendered as `¥5.00` instead of `¥500`.

**Fix:** I added a zero-decimal set (`JPY`) to `money.js`. For those currencies, the amount is printed as whole units with no division.

This also corrects yen amounts on invoices and cart totals, since they use the same helper. No other test covers JPY, so nothing else changed. I did not commit anything.
